title: The Coastal Shipping Act, 2025

metadata.ministry: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

full_text: The Coastal Shipping Act, 2025 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 2025-20 Act Number: 20 Enactment Date: 2025-08-09 Act Year: 2025 Short Title: The Coastal Shipping Act, 2025 Long Title: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to regulation of coastal shipping, promote coasting trade and encourage domestic participation therein, to ensure that India is equipped with a coastal fleet, owned and operated by the citizens of India for its national security and commercial needs, and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
